theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (r s : ℝ) (z : Rn n), r + ‖z‖ ≤ s → AEStronglyMeasurable h (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) s)) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖h (x - z) - h x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) s, ‖h x‖ₑ ^ 2
